name: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd
title: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd - 544367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 margins strong (gross 47.2%, EBITDA 25.2% reported, 28.3% ex-Ind AS 29) but capacity is ramping slowly: Sangli trials only this month, approvals ~six months, FY27 guidance held at 20% growth with no raise.

utilisation.quote: Each of the factories is sitting on more than two years of order book almost at this moment, close to two years of order book and at the last capacities.

capex.peers_comment: Chinese HVDC entrants described as de-rated and not operational; no capacity additions by peers discussed.
capex.quote: We are investing ahead of demand because we see a significant opportunity moving forward.

triggers.label: Sangli trials slip to ~6-month approval
triggers.quote: it will take us, I think, as we guided, about six months from the day we open up the facility for audits.

triggers.label: Order book ~1,945 cr, ~15 months execution
triggers.quote: This order book what we have, Rahul, this order book is slated to completion in the next 15 months, give and take.

triggers.label: Coil margin cautioned for Q3
triggers.quote: we expect some temporary moderation in standalone margins, particularly in Q3

guidance.quote: we have guided to 20% at this moment. We'll stick our guns to it.
Please model us at 20% or high teens EBITDA.
FY28, we have given a guidance of 50%.
I think our revised guidance for Mehru would be around 18%.
we see about at least USD80 million of business coming in.

red_flags.label: Ind AS 29 hyperinflation loss ₹7.82 cr; cash drawn down
red_flags.quote: Cash balances have reduced because we are facing... funding this expansion largely through internal resources rather than debt.

red_flags.label: Acquisition of closed plant with lock-box, sizeable capex
red_flags.quote: For us, it's a lockbox agreement till the day of the acquisition, any losses is to the owners account.

evasions.topic: Sangli revenue ramp / FY27 revenue quantum
evasions.quote: at this moment, our first focus is to get the factory in order before we start revising targets.
Endoks you will have to give us some time.
I don't think we have the data on hand.

summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue INR256.4 crore with reported PAT INR46.7 crore; gross margin rose to 47.2% and order book stood at INR1,945 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue was INR256.4 crore and reported EBITDA INR64.7 crore (25.2% margin). Excluding a INR7.82 crore non-cash Ind AS 29 hyperinflation loss on Turkish operations, management cited adjusted EBITDA of INR72.5 crore (28.3%) and PAT of INR54.5 crore. The order book closed at INR1,945 crore, about 1.9x last year's revenue. Sangli machinery installation is under way with trial production targeted this month, but customer audits mean meaningful volume is guided for Q3-Q4. Management guided FY27 revenue growth of 20% and standalone EBITDA of around 20% or high teens, and flagged likely temporary margin moderation in Q3 from new capacity fixed costs and aluminium pass-through.

financial_highlights.change: Year-on-year growth not stated for group; Quality Power standalone rose from INR37 crore to INR69 crore per management
Increased; to rise as Sangli and Endoks capacity is capitalised

financial_highlights.value: INR1,945 crore (Endoks INR801 crore, Mehru INR585 crore, Quality Power standalone INR553 crore)

segments.name: Quality Power standalone
segments.commentary: Order book INR553 crore; standalone revenue INR69 crore per management, up from INR37 crore. Management expects standalone EBITDA of around 20% and flagged Q3 margin moderation from Sangli fixed costs and aluminium cost lag.

segments.name: Mehru
segments.commentary: Revenue about INR83 crore, up from about INR60 crore. Q1 EBITDA about 18% versus internal target of 22-23%, hit by copper and oil price spikes in April; revised guidance to around 18%. Order book INR585 crore; capacity near 100% utilisation.

segments.name: Endoks (Turkey, power electronics / BESS)
segments.commentary: Contributed about INR107 crore revenue; Turkish revenue dipped slightly due to Eid holidays. Order book INR801 crore. Power conversion system facility civil works complete, operations expected Q3 FY27. Pipeline about USD60 million BESS PCS orders, with USD40 million more expected in 12 months.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at 20%; management declined to raise it before Q3, saying revision may come then.
Margin guidance: model around 20% or high-teens EBITDA; coil products stable guidance about 20%, with most recent orders booked above 25%.
Q3 FY27 standalone margin moderation expected from new Sangli fixed costs and aluminium cost pass-through; margins expected to normalise as utilisation rises over the next 15 months.
Sangli coil facility: trial production targeted this month; commercial revenue to trickle in from Q3, meaningful from Q4. Peak revenue potential about INR1,500-1,800 crore.
HVDC magnet wire facility: full production targeted by Q4 FY27 after three to five months of stabilisation.

WS Insulators acquisition: consolidation expected from Q4 FY27 after SEZ approvals; EV about INR315 crore. Insulator order target of about INR200 crore over next nine months; standalone potential INR250-300 crore without capex, INR450-500 crore with capex.
Management indicated FY28 growth guidance of 50%, pending order book and delivery timelines.
Order book slated for completion in about 15 months.
Interim dividend of INR0.25 per share declared.
capex_capacity: Sangli new facility: machinery installation in progress; last-mile issues around sequencing, utilities and statutory approvals; building completion certificate pending. Approvals and about 60 global customer audits expected to take about six months; initial ISO/OHSAS audits about one month.
HVDC CTC magnet wire facility at Sangli: machinery installation commencing; full production targeted Q4 FY27.

Endoks PCS facility: civil complete; interiors and power electronics fit-out in progress; facility estimated at about USD70-80 million revenue capacity for about USD2 million capex plus about USD1 million further spend.
Winwin Speciality (Vizag, SEZ): about 40 acres of land; planned INR50 crore capex for capacity; about 120 people on site.
Possible second facility decision (Turkey or Vizag for European and export markets) in 6-7 months.
Fundraise of less than INR500 crore planned, including Winwin acquisition funding, INR50 crore capex and US sales entry; roadshows from 20 August and raise targeted before AGM.
demand_pricing: Demand strong across businesses; energy storage at Endoks has inquiry levels ahead of expectations. Data-centre bids of about USD100 million seen, but 12-month delivery periods limit participation for now.
Two large HVDC programmes expected: one partly awarded (expected Q3-Q4) and Barmer tender close to award. About half a dozen STATCOM projects in talks across US, Europe and Australia.
Management said order acceptance is not the constraint; capacity ramp is. Factories sit on close to two years of order book at current capacity.
Every executable order in the book was booked above the margin guidance communicated to the market; pricing discipline maintained.
Group procurement consolidation (CPO appointed) expected to lower aluminium casting and other input costs; about INR3 crore of volume discounts benefited Q1.
Chinese HVDC bidders: management views the four Chinese entities allowed to bid as non-operational with limited near-term threat; local content norms unchanged at 60-70%.
